notes: Tiles were mostly large enough to read the main grid, digits, badges and titles clearly. Two things I was not fully certain of at this resolution: (1) in frames 4 and 9 the orange-highlighted cell shows what looks like the letter 'O' rather than a digit '0' -- it might just be a callout circle drawn around a normal '0' that reads as a letter at this size, so I flagged it as illegible/ambiguous rather than a hard overlap. (2) near row C's first cell in frames 7-13 there is a small annotation label that appears to be partly occluded by the cell border -- I could not confidently read the full word (it looks like 'ordered') because of the overlap itself, so the exact text is a guess. Frame 13 also appeared to be missing the 'C before: [...]' / 'A: [...]' summary text that similar frames (9-12) show at top right, but I couldn't be sure this wasn't just an image-resolution artifact, so I did not report it as a defect. The left-side vertical relation labels ('A || C', 'C <= A') with their up/down arrows looked intentional and did not appear to run off any tile edge.
